visual_differentiation_axes: lunar control dashboard instead of cave console or farm/ranch panels
oxygen and battery gauges as primary HUD shapes instead of score pills
moon gray, oxygen teal, solar amber, vacuum navy, and warning red palette
electromagnetic salvage claw icon with satellite scrap and oxygen canister
blueprint base repair module motifs on results and upgrade screens
strict clear central hook field with HUD anchored to instrument zones
forbidden_visual_reuse: do not reuse the brass crystal hook icon or emerald cave badge
do not reuse a generic gold hook on nugget icon
do not reuse farm crates, animal portraits, medical station cards, tower shields, swords, or card table motifs
do not reuse top rounded HUD pills plus bottom command strip if it hides the salvage field
do not use fantasy parchment, bright ranch pastel cards, or candy puzzle board motifs

ui_identity.layout_archetype: lunar control dashboard with central salvage field, top cart rail, upper-corner life-support gauges, side repair schematic rail, and compact bottom control pods
ui_identity.hud_composition: oxygen segmented gauge upper-left, battery segmented gauge upper-right, hull and parts mini readouts near the cart rail, repair objective strip on the right, scan and boost controls near bottom corners
ui_identity.navigation_model: menu to region select to gameplay to base repair or upgrade workshop to result, with pause and help as overlays
ui_identity.palette_signature: moon gray, dark vacuum navy, oxygen teal, solar amber, warning red, and instrument white
ui_identity.material_language: brushed dark metal panels, frosted glass readouts, EVA control buttons, caution stripes, lunar dust texture, cable metal, and blueprint module lines
ui_identity.typography_style: compact technical sans style using uppercase English labels and clear numeric gauges
ui_identity.primary_ui_pack: skin_military_tech with lunar dashboard token tuning and module schematic motifs

reserved_edges: top 14 percent for cart rail and life-support instruments
right 16 percent for repair objective and scan readout
bottom 12 percent for left right cart controls and magnet boost
playfield_safety.frame_overlay_policy: decorative frames and bezels must stay in reserved instrument zones and must never cover hook collision targets, meteor lanes, or collectible objects

unique_screen_motifs: region select as moon map with damaged base silhouette
base repair as blueprint sockets filling with recovered parts
result as mission log with oxygen and battery leftovers
help as compact EVA manual diagram
forbidden_ui_elements: wide bottom card strip covering the debris field

icon_identity.subject: electromagnetic salvage claw lifting a broken satellite panel and oxygen canister from a moon crater
icon_identity.silhouette: diagonal cable and hooked magnet head, angular satellite scrap, round oxygen canister, crescent lunar horizon
icon_identity.composition: magnet claw enters from upper-left, satellite panel fills center, oxygen canister sits lower-right, moon crater horizon and small stars sit behind
icon_identity.palette: oxygen teal, solar amber, moon gray, dark navy, instrument white, small warning red
icon_identity.background: dark lunar crater badge with subtle stars and a pale moon rim
icon_identity.game_specific_motif: magnetic salvage and life-support recovery rather than gold, crystals, farming, ranch care, or combat
forbidden_icon_reuse: no brass claw gripping emerald crystal
no farm crate or market stall
no animal face or medical kit
no shield tower sword or card crown
no generic spaceship without hook and oxygen canister
